crossRefs.note: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
“Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
If anyone teaches a different doctrine, and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to…
he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy…

translations.web: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
translations.bsb: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
translations.kjv: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.
translations.asv: If any man thinketh that he knoweth anything, he knoweth not yet as he ought to know;
